name: MemMachine
summary: Open-source multi-layered memory for agents (episodic, profile, working memory). Apache-2.0; self-host free, managed Pro from $79/project/month. Incubated by MemVerge.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (MemVerge, Inc., a Delaware corporation at 1525 McCarthy Blvd, Milpitas, CA). MemMachine was initially incubated by MemVerge and, per the pricing FAQ, is now community-driven with MemVerge still assigning engineering. The MemMachine/MemMachine repository is Apache-2.0, not archived, and was pushed 2026-11-16. Homepage https://memmachine.ai (HTTP 200). Docs at https://docs.memmachine.ai/getting_started/introduction (HTTP 200; the docs root 308s there and is not used). It is a model-agnostic long-term memory system with short-term, long-term, and personalized memory (episodic graph, profile SQL, working memory). Integrations named in the docs include LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, AWS Strands, n8n, Dify, and FastGPT. The Python client on the PyPI JSON API is memmachine-client 0.4.0, Apache-2.0, not yanked; memmachine-server 0.4.0 is also published. Documented `pip install memmachine-client` was not executed. README also documents MCP stdio/http entry points (memmachine-mcp-stdio / memmachine-mcp-http). Official MCP tools docs are at https://docs.memmachine.ai/api_reference/mcp (HTTP 200; tools add_memory, search_memory, and delete_memory). The older https://docs.memmachine.ai/integrations/mcp path still returns 404 and is not used as docs or a source. This entry does not set mcp_endpoint (those stdio/http entry points were not probed). Pricing (https://memmachine.ai/pricing/, HTTP 200; bare /pricing 301s there): a sandbox test drive is free. Open Source is $0 forever, self-hosted on the operator's infrastructure. Pro is $79/month billed per project, with a yearly option that saves 15%, managed cloud hosting, higher rate limits, premium integrations, and email and chat support; the pricing page says cancel anytime. Enterprise is custom (on-premise or VPC, custom SLAs, SSO). Hosted terms (https://memmachine.ai/terms-of-service/) are MemVerge Terms of Service for MemMachine Services and apply to hosted offerings, not to the Apache-2.0 Open Source Version (which the terms say is not subject to those Terms). Fees are paid in advance monthly or annually as set in the Order, in US dollars; all fees are non-refundable except as expressly stated (a limited warranty may, at MemVerge's sole discretion, fix a defect or refund applicable Fees if notice is given within 30 days). Subscriptions auto-renew unless a party gives written notice at least 30 calendar days before the then-current term ends. The Terms also say the Customer shall not have the right to terminate for convenience. Binding arbitration and a class-action waiver are called out up front. Privacy policy (https://memmachine.ai/privacy-policy/, last updated May 20th, 2026) names Google Analytics and other partners for usage analytics, cookies and similar technologies, and contact privacy@memverge.com. https://console.memmachine.ai 307s to /dashboard and is not used as url, docs, or a source. No signup, self-host deploy, or spend.
